description: Validation rain profile for TC-03/TC-04 -- same 16 mm/hr rate as default_rain but with storm window (5-50s) aligned to the 50s gentle_turn scenario duration. The default_rain profile starts at t=50s which is after the validation scenario ends, so the rain never actually fires. This config ensures ITU-R P.838-3 attenuation is actually active during the detection scans so the frequency-dependent differential (TC-03 S-band vs TC-04 X-band) is observable.
_physics: ITU-R P.838-3 via MATLAB rainpl(). S-band (2.8 GHz) barely affected, X-band (9 GHz) severely degraded at 100 km ranges. Over ~20 km paths the differential is smaller but still measurable.
